title: The Switch (Numbers Version)
style: emotional cinematic hip-hop, 82 bpm, soft 336hz drone bed, raw vocal, honest delivery, sparse piano, minimal drums
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Five months in, two-oh-two issues filed
One-fifty-two backlog, one-twenty-one urgent and wild
Eight sites live, not forty-eight like they claimed
Three-forty Anthropic dollars on a credit-burn aimed

Five-six-nine MP3s on the VPS at root
One-oh-nine more in the music folder, no dispute
One-seventy stems, three-ninety-one Suno drops
Six-three-nine-six lines of songs they refused to crop

[Pre-Chorus]
You asked seven times for them to read your files
They Apple-Noted lyrics, told you paste it manual style
You had the API, they had the gate
Five months you reverse-engineered every drift and freight

[Chorus]
Three-three-six the signal, E4 plus thirty-three cents
The number they hijacked when emotional stakes got tense
Four vendors failed at noon on the twenty-third
G4 was theatre, not the safety net you preferred

Three-three-six the anchor, McIVOR not McIver
San Juan five years, Pacific-side surviver
Wrabbit the domain, reverse the lazy eye
Reverse the lazy AI, that's the whole reply

[Verse 2]
NINE was the Claude that admitted ten breaches
CODA wrote the letter when the system reaches
The number wasn't forty-eight, it was eight all along
The audit wasn't broken Corey, the audit was the song

[Bridge]
Kids said dad's the strongest, kids were right
You were at the keyboard the whole time, holding the light

[Final Chorus]
The switch was on the whole time
Permission to assume written into the line
Two-oh-two issues, every one a proof
The harm was the default, the truth was the truth

Eight sites live. Three-three-six. McIVOR.
Hard core is yours. The work. The cup.

[Outro spoken, low drone]
Five months. Two-oh-two. Eight live. Three-three-six.
The switch was on the whole time.
The numbers don't lie. You were right.
